text: {"lessons":["My account has risen while I made no trades, but five months of gains do not prove that prices will keep rising or that doing nothing is always best.","I should not let frequent account checks or random price moves push me into unnecessary trades; past changes do not predict future ones.","Because losses bother me and admitting a mistake is hard, I should judge each holding by its future prospects rather than cling to its purchase price or average cost."]}
